title: Then all being gone, a glance of motherwit helping, he whispers close in going: Madam, when comes the storkbird for thee?
html_source: A mother’s intuition, or innate ability to know is something Pallas Athena in The Odyssey used to sustain Odysseus. This is Stephen asking “Madam,” or motherwit, “When will the storkbird come to you to deliver this innate ability to know to me as my inherited gift from you?” Joyce has given Stephen a glimpse of this “motherwit,” he recognizes it and now craves it for himself.
